ticketing.notes: Flat tariff from the festival's Pricing & Passes page. Tickets are sold through the festival site's basket, run on ethos.smarticket.co.il; call centre *9300. Cancellation is allowed up to 7 days before the screening.

venues.name: Auditorium
venues.accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the sides of rows 2-4.
venues.notes: Haifa Auditorium, in the Carmel Centre complex. It has 1,139 seats (up to 1,453 in other configurations) on a single rake with no balcony. The festival's own pages give the address as HaNassi 142. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded.

venues.name: Cinematheque
venues.notes: Haifa Cinematheque, in the same HaNassi 138-142 block (another page gives 140). It has two cinemas, but the festival's schedule labels both 'Cinematheque', so no screening is assigned a room and no seat count is known. The research noted wheelchair spaces in row 9 without recording where that came from, so accessibility stays null. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded; same block as the Auditorium.

venues.name: Kriger (Carmel Zarfati)
venues.accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the ends of row 15.
venues.notes: Krieger Centre for the Performing Arts, in Carmel Zarfati ('French Carmel'), which is a neighbourhood and not the hall's name. The source gives the capacity as about 500. It is a 15-minute drive from the Carmel Centre, with a festival shuttle. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded.

venues.name: Mirrors Hall
venues.notes: Mirrors Hall inside Beit Hecht, in the same block, used for industry events only. Another page gives HaNassi 138. No seat count found. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded; same block as the Auditorium.

venues.name: Rapaport
venues.accessibility: Wheelchair spaces in the first row.
venues.notes: The (new) Rappaport Hall, in the Rappaport Centre in the same HaNassi 138-142 block as the Auditorium, so the walk between them is close to zero. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded; same block as the Auditorium.

venues.name: Tikotin
venues.notes: The Raphael Auditorium of the Tikotin Museum of Japanese Art, a 10-15 minute walk from the Carmel Centre complex. habama.co.il (hall 222) shows a seating map but no seat count. Coordinates are approximate, not geocoded.
